# The first-link Discard of a folder that takes server entries along needs engine tests for each shape the sim model found: held folders inside the taken-along folder, a change inside a held folder, a conflict name only the device has not applied, and a server entry another device moves in that the user then deletes. Each test also runs after a restart, and the moved-in case runs from a store written before the new table, because the outcome depends on persisted Discard state that no existing first_link test restores.
